description: The reported strategy is the best of 200 pure-noise series; all 200 are declared and logged.
comment: The best of 200 noise series has an annualised Sharpe of 1.12 and looks significant as a single test; the expected maximum of 200 noise Sharpe ratios is about 2.75 / sqrt(T) per period, so the deflated Sharpe is near 0.5.
